source.title: Agent not recognizing the workflow inputs

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body: ## Describe the problem/error/question I created an agent and added an existing workflow. The workflow trigger is "When Executed by Another Workflow" and it accepts three input values. The inputs are not recognized in the agent. ## What is the error message (if any)? This workflow has no defined inputs. Define inputs in its trigger to configure them here. ## Please share your workflow/screenshots/recording ``` (Select the nodes on your canvas and use the keyboard shortcuts CMD+C/CTRL+C and CMD+V/CTRL+V to copy and paste the workflow.) ⚠️ WARNING ⚠️ If you have sensitive data in your workflow (like API keys), please remove it before sharing. ``` ## Share the output returned by the last node Not needed ## Debug info ### core - n8nVersion: 2.45.6 - platform: docker (self-hosted) - nodeJsVersion: 26.12.1 - nodeEnv: production - database: postgres - executionMode: scaling (single-main) - concurrency: -1 - license: enterprise (production) ### storage - success: all - error: all - progress: false - manual: true - binaryMode: database ### pruning - enabled: true - maxAge: 336 hours - maxCount: 10000 executions ### client - userAgent: mozilla/5.0 (windows nt 10.0; win64; x64) applewebkit/537.36 (khtml, like gecko) chrome/156.0.0.0 safari/537.36 edg/156.0.0.0 - isTouchDevice: false Generated at: 2026-11-03T05:27:10.878Z
